newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money market active, supply abundant.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money market active, supply abundant.

text.p: Croatian money market was marked on Tuesday morning by active trade with supply exceeding demand, traders said.
"The demand was too low against the abundant offer, so some kuna funds could not be placed," one dealer said.
Fresh loans totalled 20 million kuna. Call money rate was steady at 11 percent. Short-term loans were made at 12 at 13 percent and one one-month deal was struck at 15 percent.
Overnight trade totalled 57.8 million kuna which went to four banks to maintain their mandatory reserves. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
